name: fix-loader-extra-top-level-entries
body: Amendment, solution tier. Source statement: solution.component.template-library-loader's body stated the layout check accepts only library.yaml, slides/, sections/, themes/, media/ at top level plus the single inert root entry `AGENTS.md`, with every other unknown top-level entry an error. Inconsistency: requirements.requirement.templates-dir-layout/-validation and requirements.requirement.library-guide-layout were amended [with user] so that a library root's unrelated top-level entries — a `.git/` directory in the common git-repo case, a `README.md`, an editor lockfile — are ignored and inert rather than errors. Resolution: amended the loader's body to 'the loader validates only the library itself; any other top-level entry is ignored (library-guide-layout), never parsed, validated, rendered, listed or served'. The checkTopLevelLayout unknown-entry rejection was removed; fail-fast ordering, file:line qualification and the theme/media reference checks are unchanged. Supersedes solution.note.fix-loader-agents-md.
